name: skillpool
description: Switchable Claude Code profiles: each profile is a folder with its own CLAUDE.md (rules and memory), skills picked from a shared pool, and plugin/MCP/model switches, layered on top of your global and project setup. `skillpool <profile>` starts claude with one; /skillpool <profile> switches mid-session; /skillpool:doctor suggests profiles from your real usage; each profile also becomes a skillpool-<profile> subagent.
